# Supplementary Figure 6 — family II inorganic pyrophosphatase (PPAC_BACSU)

Closed vs open states of the *B. subtilis* low-molecular-weight protein-tyrosine
phosphatase: **2HAW** (closed) vs **1K23** (open), scored by Cα-RMSD to each reference
(x = `2haw_rmsd`, y = `1k23_rmsd`).

**Method.** m-fold sampling spreads the MSA across the 2HAW/1K23 RMSD plane; the lowest-3%
RMSD sequences for each state are selected and the top-16 re-predicted (5 models × 8 seeds =
40 structures per state), against a 16-random-sequence control.

**Figure** = `four_panel_rmsd_scatter.png`, generated by
`results/PPAC_BACSU/run3/plot_four_panel_rmsd.py`. All sources copied (read-only) from
`results/PPAC_BACSU/run3/`.

| Panel | Backing CSV (this folder) | Source | Rows |
|-------|---------------------------|--------|------|
| m-fold sampling | `panel1_mfold_sampling_rmsd_values.csv` | `02_sampling_rmsd_analysis/rmsd_values.csv` | 4,830 |
| Closed (2HAW) top-16 | `panel2_2haw_closed_top16_prediction_rmsd.csv` | `03_rmsd_selection_3pct/2haw_top16/prediction_rmsd.csv` | 40 |
| Open (1K23) top-16 | `panel3_1k23_open_top16_prediction_rmsd.csv` | `03_rmsd_selection_3pct/1k23_top16/prediction_rmsd.csv` | 40 |
| Random-16 control | `panel4_random16_control_prediction_rmsd.csv` | `03_rmsd_selection_3pct/control_random16/prediction_rmsd.csv` | 40 |

References: `2HAW_processed_forRMSD.pdb` (res 2–308), `1K23_processed_forRMSD.pdb` (res 1–307); config `config_1k23_2haw_rmsd.json`.
